_comment: ComfyUI API-format workflow for HiDream-O1-Image Dev MXFP8 text-to-image. HiDream-O1 is a genuinely unified pixel-native ~8B model: its Qwen3-VL text backbone runs inside diffusion_model.* every sampling step, and its decoder is a pixel-space conversion VAE. So CheckpointLoaderSimple supplies MODEL, CLIP (a tokenizer-only TE) and VAE all three -- do NOT add a separate CLIPLoader, and do not load the Gemma-4 encoder here; in the official template that encoder sits inside a 'Prompt Enhancement' subgraph driving a TextGenerate node, i.e. it is an optional LLM prompt rewriter, not this model's text encoder. Settings track the official Dev template (Comfy-Org/workflow_templates, image_hidream_o1_dev.json): SamplerLCM rather than KSamplerSelect, and cfg 1.0 -- Dev is guidance-distilled, so cfg above 1.0 does not just waste time, it overcooks: measured at 2048x2048 on a 16GB RTX 5080, cfg 5.0 produced blown highlights, chromatic speckle and invented clutter, and ran ~50x slower (44-51 s/step vs ~1.0, peaking 15.7GB of 16.3GB) because ComfyUI only skips the uncond pass at exactly 1.0 and the doubled batch no longer fits. Node 5 is therefore inert; it stays because SamplerCustom requires a negative input. The SamplerCustom chain is needed so ModelNoiseScale can set the absolute training noise scale: 7.6 for Dev, 8.0 for base (8.0 is also the built-in default in comfy/supported_models.py). For the base model, point ckpt_name at hidream_o1_image_mxfp8.safetensors and follow the official Full template instead: KSamplerSelect / dpmpp_2m_sde_gpu, cfg 5.0, 40 steps, noise_scale 8.0. Requires ComfyUI from 2026-05-12 or later (PR #13817), which added both the HiDreamO1* nodes and SamplerLCM. Width/height default to 2048x2048, matching both official templates and the node's own default -- this is the single biggest quality lever on the model, not a preference. HiDream-O1 patchifies raw RGB at patch_size=32 with no VAE, so 1024x1024 yields only (1024/32)^2 = 1024 tokens: a quarter of what FLUX.2 (VAE downscale 16, patch_size 1) gets at the same output size, and below every ~4MP bucket the model was trained on. EmptyHiDreamO1LatentImage's own help text says lower resolutions 'go off-distribution and quality regresses noticeably'. Measured on an RTX 5080: 2048x2048 is ~28s with the model resident, peaking ~11.7GB of 16GB. Reduce only if VRAM forces it, and expect visibly softer, less detailed output when you do. HiDreamO1PatchSeamSmoothing (node 12) is included because a patch-based pixel transformer leaves a visible rectangular seam grid in flat texture -- wood grain, paper, bokeh. It runs extra offset passes over the last 20% of sampling and blends them, which measurably cleans that up; the official Dev template omits the node and the Full template runs it with passes ramp_2_4 / blend median. Drop the node and rewire 8/9 to node 3 if you want raw speed. Replace PROMPT_TEXT, WIDTH, HEIGHT, SEED, and FILENAME_PREFIX as needed.
